title: Smiling Female Teacher at Desk with Book, 1960s Vintage Classroom Photo
description: A black-and-white portrait of a smiling mature woman seated at a classroom desk, likely an educator or teacher. She wears a button-up cardigan sweater over a collared shirt adorned with a patterned scarf and cameo brooch. She holds an open textbook and pen in one hand, while gesturing with her spectacles in the other. In the background, metal filing cabinets or school lockers and posted papers are visible, evoking mid-century institutional and academic life.
